Markets.title: Anthropic IPO share orders from China are said to be rebuffed
Markets.summary: Anthropic has excluded investors from mainland China and Hong Kong from placing orders in its upcoming November 18 IPO due to US-China technological sensitivities. Despite this restriction, some affected investors are attempting to join the public offering using offshore structures.

Markets.title: BofA adds January Fed hike to forecast, says quarterly pace no longer enough
Markets.summary: Bank of America added a forecast for a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate hike in January 2027 following a higher-than-expected October Consumer Price Index report. Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank also revised their interest rate forecasts due to the recent inflation data.

Markets.title: US stocks: US stocks reverse early gains as Nvidia turmoil hits tech sector
Markets.summary: US stocks fell as leadership turmoil at Nvidia triggered a broader technology selloff, sending the Nasdaq down 1.42% and the S&P 500 nearly 1% lower. Investors also weighed softer-than-expected producer inflation against the outlook for interest rates and the wider AI trade.

Markets.title: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says on CNBC the Fed needs to guard against demand overheating
Markets.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee stated that rising demand from the artificial intelligence buildout is driving up prices across the health care and service sectors. He emphasized that the Federal Reserve must guard against demand overheating and rely on upcoming inflation data to determine its interest rate pace.

Markets.title: US Treasury chief says Fed should not hike rates over energy shock tied to Iran war
Markets.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the Federal Reserve to avoid raising interest rates in response to energy price shocks from the conflict in Iran. He argued that current economic indicators are skewed by supply disruptions and maintained that the US economy remains robust despite market volatility.

Markets.title: MAN Industries PAT rises to Rs 82 cr in Q2
Markets.summary: MAN Industries reported a consolidated profit after tax of Rs 82 crore for the September quarter, driven by higher revenue and the acquisition of National Pipe Company. The positive financial performance occurred despite temporary shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

Geo-Political.title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision
Geo-Political.summary: All passengers were successfully rescued after a cruise ship collided on the Mississippi River in New Orleans. Thirty-two people were hospitalized with non-critical injuries, but everyone has been accounted for.

Geo-Political.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
Geo-Political.summary: Microsoft apologized after a global technology outage caused nearly 24 hours of widespread disruption. Experts stated the incident highlights the world's heavy reliance on a small number of major tech providers.

Geo-Political.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
Geo-Political.summary: Microsoft is still working to restore global services like Outlook and Teams following a major outage. The company has not yet confirmed whether any emails have been permanently lost.

Geo-Political.title: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
Geo-Political.summary: A server outage has disrupted multiple Microsoft services, including Teams, Outlook, and the Copilot AI software. The technical failure is currently impacting user access across these platforms.

Geo-Political.title: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
Geo-Political.summary: SpaceX aborted an attempted mechanical catch of its Starship rocket booster during a recent test flight. Instead of being caught by the launch tower, the booster splashed down into the ocean.

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin is increasing his demands for peace with Ukraine while showing no willingness to compromise. According to BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg, Moscow views the inclusion of European security in these discussions as a victory.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A digital creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights the growing shift from traditional SEO to AI-driven traffic optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide outlines the top ten AI tools designed to revolutionize and simplify the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores the top 10 advanced artificial intelligence tools of 2023 used across various industries. These tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase overall productivity.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article helps users find the right AI content generator for their needs. It introduces various artificial intelligence tools designed to create effective and engaging content efficiently.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This guide explains how beginners can use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also provides examples of top programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Indian solar manufacturers look to Germany as China proposes curbs on technology exports
Data & Insights.summary: China is proposing curbs on solar technology exports that could negatively impact India's goal of building a domestic solar manufacturing ecosystem. Specifically, these restrictions threaten India's projection to reach 100 gigawatts of capacity for wafers, ingots, and polysilicon by the end of the decade, leading Indian manufacturers to look to Germany instead.

Data & Insights.title: Trade deficit widens to 1-year high of $39.88 billion in October on record imports
Data & Insights.summary: India's trade deficit widened to a one-year high of $39.88 billion in October due to record imports. Although both exports and imports experienced strong growth, the absolute increase in imports outpaced exports.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation hits 6.09% in October, crosses RBI's upper tolerance limit
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit. This figure also surpassed the 6% two-year high estimated by economists in a Mint poll.

Data & Insights.title: 'New state law to shield investors in Andhra Pradesh'
Data & Insights.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning a new Investment Protection Act and escrow accounts to guarantee policy continuity and incentives for investors. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu is also introducing reforms to accelerate business and economic growth in the state.

Data & Insights.title: Moody’s raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast to 7%. The agency expects the country to sustain this growth rate through 2028, driven by strong domestic demand and economic resilience.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's ups India's FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong economic momentum, warns of risks
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's has increased India's fiscal year 2027 growth forecast from 6.5% to 7% due to strong economic momentum. However, the agency warned that inflation, deficient monsoons, and rising El Niño risks could threaten this growth.

India.title: Drugs Worth Rs 1 Crore Seized From Chennai Plastic Products Factory
India.summary: Authorities seized precursor chemicals worth Rs 1 crore from a plastic products factory in Chennai. The approximately 50 kg of illicit substances were found hidden inside two gunny bags at M/s AN Enterprises.

India.title: Centre Revises Maritime Flag Rules For Merchant Ships, Government Vessels
India.summary: The Indian government has updated the maritime flag rules for merchant ships and government vessels. Under the new rules, all government-owned vessels must fly the Blue Ensign along with their respective departmental badge.

India.title: Cop On Security Duty At Panjab University Shoots Himself Dead
India.summary: A police officer on security duty at Panjab University shot and killed himself. The incident occurred inside a room near the university's Botanical Garden.

India.title: 25 Killed, Several Injured In Truck-Bus Collision In Assam's Kaziranga
India.summary: A collision between a truck and a minibus in Assam's Kaziranga killed 25 people and injured several others. The crash occurred at Rongajan when the truck rammed the minibus traveling from Bokakhat to Nagaon.

India.title: Centre Extends Ban On Zakir Naik's Islamic Foundation For 5 More Years
India.summary: The Indian government has extended the ban on Zakir Naik's Islamic Research Foundation for an additional five years. Authorities stated that Naik used various media platforms to deliver radical statements that inspired youths in India and abroad to commit terrorist acts.

India.title: Kangana Ranaut Faces Police Case Over "Mysterious Foreigner" X Post On Sonia Gandhi
India.summary: An Indian police case has been filed against actor and politician Kangana Ranaut over an X post regarding Sonia Gandhi. The complainant alleged that her posts attempted to cast suspicion on the deaths of Indira, Sanjay, and Rajiv Gandhi.

General.title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision
General.summary: A cruise ship collided on the Mississippi River in New Orleans, resulting in the rescue of all passengers. Thirty-two people were hospitalized with non-critical injuries, and no one is missing.

General.title: US Air Force says it responded to 'suspected drones' over RAF Lakenheath
General.summary: The US Air Force reported suspected unauthorized drone activity over RAF Lakenheath. The American military confirmed there were no injuries or damage resulting from the incident.

General.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
General.summary: The White House announced that Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping plan to hold a historic joint meeting in China next week. A spokeswoman stated that Trump will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons during these unprecedented talks.

General.title: Police investigating David Walliams over reports alleging serious sexual offences
General.summary: The Metropolitan Police are investigating David Walliams following allegations of serious sexual offences. Authorities stated these new allegations are separate from recent reports published by ITV and the Guardian.

General.title: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
General.summary: Elon Musk’s company aborted an attempted catch of the rocket’s booster - instead it came down in the ocean.
